title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Family and Religious Studies Paper 1
description: A practice paper in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Family and Religious Studies Paper 1 (religions): four 25-mark questions chosen from eight, 100 marks, 2 hours 30 minutes. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **any four** questions. You have 2 hours 30 minutes. Each question is worth 25 marks: part (a) 15 marks and part (b) 10 marks.

- The questions cover the concept of religion, Indigenous Religion, Judaism, Christianity and Islam.
- If you answer more than four questions, your best four count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The paper structure and the 15 + 10 split are our convention: the syllabus gives only the paper totals. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
